name: Wobble J0: O20 hub 0 stacked UNDER hub 1 of the lead conecut-knee-knuckle-3r (hub 1 on a Ti wedge, J1's axis on a cone of half-angle a0; 4 counted joints, the user prefers 3)
lens: round103:relay-under-lead (lens 1: the a0 <= 20 'stackable inside J1's footprint' clause)

claim_frozen_exact.bench: Bench(110,360) exact, frozen lead, window [0, 21] from the fit bench

verdict: DEAD on the clash count: hub 0 at hub 1's level jams on hub K and on the riser link 1a needs (L1a must ride hub 1's boss and drop 13-24 mm in the 4 mm gap to hub K), losing 11-170 of the lead's poses at every legal seat; where hub 0's lobe points into the chain's free sector the skin is high on overhead poses and hub 0 floats (r0 76-86). Best legal 28.10 fast / 32.92 frozen exact Bench(110,360) vs the 3-joint lead 12.50 / 18.28; the relay buys nothing on the claim bench (2 candidates, both outside the window).
limiter: stack clashes (measured, claim bench): riser vs hub 0 35 poses, hub 0 vs hub K 7, incl. 5 frames of the scapular-plane overhead clip (plane 30, elev 124-150: riser 1.7-1.9 mm into hub 0) -> reach 0.647, follow 0.90; hub 1's exposed crescent (33/80) and L1a 0 % in band (median 21 / 30 mm) -> ib14 0.880; relay 0 poses at a0 6.
note: Convergence gate (Bench(60,160) fast, 122 legal configs of 149 in order): best gain over the 2nd half 0.14 score pts, last third 0.14, top-5 spread 0.31 -> converged. 27 configs sat on seat-illegal hub-0 axes (a0 >= 10 at azu 150-210) and are nulled in the sweep (numbers kept under measured_seat_illegal). Spec arithmetic (+7.4 dilution) overstates: covered hub-1 samples are not skin-facing, measured +2.0-2.7. Counterfactual with the riser deleted (unbuildable): 19.21 fast vs lead 12.50. Not modelled (generous): hub 0's skin-level ground bracket. Continuity flood not run (connected <= static). Ghost on the fit bench 11.88 (lead 12.50): a0 6-12 relays 1-12 of the 36 lost fit poses. Simplicity record: lead's mechanism + J0 (counted, spring-centred, own-angle dowel stops, MR117 pair in O20 v5) + Ti wedge plate + L1a riser (5-axis from solid).
